name: Raddent
look: a rat whose body is a round magenta radish with green veins, a tan face, a pointed snout, a buck tooth and whiskers, scurrying on four stubby feet with its leafy top sprouting out behind
entry: It plants itself in a vegetable patch and pretends to be a radish until the farmer goes home, then nibbles everything in sight. Pull on its leaves and it squeaks and bolts.
how: Wild: common in plains, grasslands, forests and villages.
